Name: Line Sprinklers
Author: Hootless
Description:
Does exactly what it sounds like (and what's in the brief overview): Adds new sprinklers called "Line Sprinklers" that water in a straight line instead of only adjacent to the sprinklers. 4 tiles in a line for Basic, 8 for Quality, and 24 for Iridium! The recipes to craft these only cost one of the sprinkler they're a variant of and are available immediately!

You can rotate the sprinklers like furniture bits while holding/placing them. On keyboard and mouse that's right click, not sure what it is on controller but it should just be the normal rotate button.

Downloads.Description:
Fixed sprinklers not watering when placed as the (U) version.
If you have Activate Sprinklers installed, you can right click placed Line Sprinklers to force them to water immediately instead of in the morning.
THIS COSTS STAMINA! So use it sparingly.
